verdict.rationale: Auth0 Organizations let you represent each business customer with its own per-organization connections and branded federated login flows. B2B marketing says enterprise clients can configure SSO themselves and verify domain ownership, which covers per-org SSO and verified domains. missing for 10: explicit evidence of just-in-time provisioning on first SSO login (only SCIM/directory sync is documented), in-depth docs on domain verification beyond marketing copy, independent or hands-on corroboration.
